title: Completed Decorations
description: Adds stairs, walls, fences and fence gates to blocks that need them.
body:
This mod adds 22 new decoritive blocks with vanila materials.

-   Blocks added : 
-   Smooth stone stairs
-   Smooth stone wall
-   Bamboo Mosaic fence
-   Bamboo Mosaic fence gate
-   Stone wall
-   Polished diorite wall
-   Polished andesite wall
-   Polished Granite wall
-   Smooth Sandstone Wall
-   Smooth Red Sandstone wall
-   Prismarine Brick Wall
-   Dark Prismarine Wall
-   Red Nether Brick fence
-   Red Nether Brick fence gate
-   Nether Brick fence gate
-   Purpur Wall 
-   Quartz Wall
-   Smooth Quartz Wall
-   Waxed Cut Copper wall
-   Waxed Exposed Cut Copper wall
-   Waxed Weathered Cut Copper wall
-   Waxed Oxidized Cut Copper wall
